$description: Citation ledger for decisions that are not a single token/section value: confirmed facts, corrected pre-investigation claims, spec-vs-code conflicts (CURRENT CODE WINS -- it was audited against the live site later than the specs) and unmeasured items. External refs need the sibling clone source; without it verify_all WARNS (never fails).

entries.claim: ia/ia.json (sibling IA, ia-builder) lists 84 routes in 23 templates: the 25 built routes in 22 templates + 59 linked-but-unbuilt routes in template.stub (rendered by src/pages/StubPage.jsx). The IA splits Season pages by exact section composition (feature-stack -> 6 IA templates, ai-product -> 3, solution -> 2); this design-repo groups by recipe (14 templates).
